title: Forward tape-skipping machine
statement: For a positive number $k$ of work tapes and a selected tape $i<k$, the machine starts in the run phase. In that phase, if the selected tape's scanned cell contains a symbol, it leaves the cell unchanged, moves that tape's head one step to the right, and remains in the run phase; if the cell is blank, it makes the same tape movement and enters the done phase. In every other phase, it leaves the work tapes unchanged, keeps the input head still, emits no output, and remains in its current phase.
hypotheses_covered: A natural number $k$ of work tapes
